arrangements.parallel_demand_prop: fresh inlet; flow share proportional to nominal zero-order uptake q_i*H_i
arrangements.parallel_maxmin: fresh inlet; shares maximise the minimum module oxygen (equalising optimum)
arrangements.parallel_uniform: fresh inlet to every module; equal flow shares
arrangements.series_limited_first: all flow through the modules in sequence, ordered by decreasing fixed-lumen drop C_in - ceiling_i

author: Red (Claude, Anthropic) via Claude Cowork; configured model id claude-opus-5-5 (the serving model may differ)
film_note: k_L = Sh*D_fluid/d_h, d_h = 2h for a wide slit, Sh = 4.86 (fully developed laminar flow, one transferring wall, other wall insulated, constant-concentration value); P_eff = 1/(1/P_wall + 1/k_L). Fully developed Sh is the conservative (lowest) value; entrance effects raise k_L. Neither PF0 nor Bonart et al. 2026 include this lumen-side series resistance.

geometries.base: every module = one channel face (W x L) plus a one-sided slab of its depth; 4 channels
geometries.two_sided_hotspot: hotspot volume supplied from both faces, i.e. two one-sided modules of half depth, each with its own channel; baseline modules unchanged; 5 channels

hydraulics.absolute_values_note: absolute dp and power depend on the assumed h and mu; the ratios between arrangements do not
hydraulics.capacity_note: PF0's capacity law changes neither flow nor viscosity, so the pump terms ignore beta (this favours the carrier)
hydraulics.pressure_rules: uniform parallel dp = R Q/N; allocated parallel (inline restrictors) dp = R max_i Q_i; series dp = N R Q; power = dp Q
hydraulics.resistance: R = 12 mu L / (W h^3 (1 - 0.630 h/W)) per module channel; identical channels; interconnects neglected

model_class: Per module, the PF0 constitutive model: steady 1-D one-sided slab, Michaelis-Menten uptake, finite wall transfer, no-flux back face, cross-sectionally well-mixed plug-flow lumen, hypothetical linear lumen capacity C_total = beta*C_free. Solved in the continuum limit (stage_transport.py: RK4 shooting plus the exact separable lumen integral), not on PF0's 24 x 32 grid.
name: AL1 heterogeneous-demand flow allocation and topology screen

numerics.refinement_subset: base geometry, P0.05_wall, r in {1,4}, hotspot depth in {100,400} um

patch.meaning: q_module = multiplier * q_ref. Hotspot multiplier = r * 0.25 (0.25, 0.5 or 1.0). Hypothetical heterogeneity spanning 0.25-1x the PF0 reference demand; not calibrated to any tissue.

pre_freeze_disclosure: Before this freeze the solver was unit-tested on synthetic patches (zero-order, first-order and identical-module limits) and the infinite-flow ceilings of candidate modules were computed to confirm that the grid spans flow-limited and transverse-limited regimes. No allocation or topology outcome on this grid was computed before the freeze.

predeclared_checks.C1_identical_modules_series_equals_unifo: |series - uniform parallel| <= 1e-9*C_in for patches whose modules are all identical
predeclared_checks.C2_zero_order_closed_forms: max-min tau and series minimum match the zero-order closed forms to 1e-5 relative; series >= max-min
predeclared_checks.C3_first_order_closed_forms: max-min tau and series minimum match the first-order closed forms to 1e-5 relative; series >= max-min
predeclared_checks.C4_maxmin_equalisation: module minima at the max-min split agree to 1e-8 relative; shares sum to the total to 1e-12 relative
predeclared_checks.C5_random_allocations_never_beat_maxmin: 200 random splits per (patch, flow) at beta=1 never exceed tau by more than 1e-9 relative
predeclared_checks.C6_monotone_in_flow_and_beta: every arrangement's worst minimum is non-decreasing in total flow and in beta (1e-12 absolute)
predeclared_checks.C7_bounded_by_ceiling: no arrangement exceeds the patch's minimum ceiling (infinite-flow limit) by more than 1e-12
predeclared_checks.C8_refinement: doubling RK4 steps and table points changes worst minima by <= 1e-7*C_in on the refinement subset

predeclared_expectations.E1: parallel_maxmin >= parallel_uniform and >= parallel_demand_prop in every configuration (optimality; failure = defect)
predeclared_expectations.E2: where the patch's minimum ceiling < 0.05, no arrangement at any beta <= 256 reaches 0.05
predeclared_expectations.E3: heterogeneous patches: median relative gain of max-min over uniform exceeds 1% where the uniform worst module is flow-limited (worst < 0.9 x minimum ceiling) and is below 1% where it is near its ceiling (>= 0.9)
predeclared_expectations.E4: series_limited_first >= parallel_maxmin at equal total flow in every configuration (proven here only for the zero-order and first-order limits; open for Michaelis-Menten kinetics)
predeclared_expectations.E5: series_limited_first equals series_best in every configuration (Jackson-rule ordering; proven only in the two limits)
predeclared_expectations.E6: where the base geometry's minimum ceiling < 0.05: two-sided hotspot at beta=1 beats the base geometry at beta=256 (both max-min, same total flow) in every configuration
predeclared_expectations.E7: secondary, equal hydraulic power at beta=1: parallel_maxmin >= series_limited_first in most configurations

question: With the same total perfusate flow, can redistributing it among heterogeneous tissue modules, or re-arranging the modules, raise the worst-region free O2; and when do allocation or carrier capacity stop helping?

reference_parameters.provenance: PF0 values (Bonart et al. 2026 illustrative liver-like case). NOT skin measurements. Km is held fixed when demand is scaled. 0.05 mol/m3 is PF0's arbitrary pass line and is used only as a reference line, not a survival criterion.

scope_limits: Liver-like PF0 reference parameters and hypothetical demand multipliers; not skin or any measured tissue.
Steady state; no axial diffusion in tissue; no lateral coupling between modules; cross-sectionally well-mixed lumen except the optional film term.
Capacity beta is PF0's hypothetical instantaneous linear equilibrium; no carrier chemistry, viscosity, release kinetics or toxicity.
Oxygen only: no glucose, CO2, lactate, pH, heat, immune, sterility, shear or mechanical-deformation model.
Series arrangements pass each module's effluent to the next; waste accumulation and failure propagation are not modelled.
Hydraulic numbers assume identical slit channels and ignore interconnects; absolute values are illustrative only.
status: computational investigation only; not a tissue, clinical or viability validation
